help.draw: Click empty space: add a note, keep dragging to move it.
help.select: Shift+drag: box select · Ctrl+Shift+drag or Ctrl+click: add to selection.
help.erase: Right-click (or drag with the right button): delete notes.
help.resize: Drag the right edge of a note: change its length.
help.snap: Hold Alt while dragging to move without snapping.
help.zoom: Ctrl+wheel: zoom time · Alt+wheel: zoom rows.
help.ruler: Ruler: click to move the cursor, drag to set a loop, double-click to clear it.
help.keys: Del delete · Ctrl+A/C/X/V/D · ↑↓ semitone (Shift: octave) · ←→ move by snap · Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo.

tips.scale: Auto picks a scale that suits the genre and mood. Pentatonic and blues scales take their chords from the parent seven-note scale.
tips.swing: Delays every second sixteenth (or eighth in jazz, shuffle and stoner rock). 100% is a full triplet feel.
tips.complexity: Higher values add more notes, busier rhythms and richer chords (sevenths, ninths).
tips.humanize: Small random shifts in timing and velocity so the pattern sounds less mechanical. The first note of the loop stays on the grid.
tips.progression: Auto chooses a preset that fits the genre and key, or generates one with a Markov chain of chord functions.
tips.chordsPerBar: How often the chord changes: ½ = every two bars, 2 = twice per bar.
tips.voiceLeading: Chooses chord inversions so each voice moves as little as possible between chords.
tips.approachNotes: Before a chord change the bass leads into the next root by step or chromatically.
tips.structure: Phrase plan for the melody: equal letters repeat the same motif, new letters bring new material.
tips.repetition: How literally a repeated motif comes back. Lower values develop it: shifted, inverted or varied.
tips.palmMute: Share of short, muted chugs versus ringing open notes.
tips.chromaticism: Chance of chromatic runs into chord changes and dark colour (♭2, tritone) over the tonic.
tips.density: Scales the optional, probabilistic hits of the groove. Fixed backbeat hits always play.
